title: Dos and Don’ts / approved palette
slide_intent: Limit additional colors so a composition does not lose its connection to the shared identity.
strategic_value: A consistent palette can keep DB campaign examples recognizable despite different content.
demonstration: A Paris-offer example using brand colors is paired with a crossed-out version using additional hues.
practical_value: Check every added color against the palette and its assigned element role.

content_islands.name: Palette comparison
content_islands.spec: Place the approved Paris composition left and the crossed-out off-palette version right.

reference_purposes.Application: The example compares palette-conforming and off-palette campaign treatments.
reference_purposes.Constraint: The source permits only brand colors according to their intended element roles and prohibits new colors outside them.
